notes: All 21 source morphemes and 21 target tokens are partitioned exactly once.
`אֵי־זֶה` is one interrogative expression headed on `אֵי`, with the verbless clause's copula joining that unit — rule 22's own `אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ` → *Where is* precedent.

`בֵּית הָרֹאֶה` → *the seer's house* puts the written *the* on the rectum's article, because an English possessive expression takes the determiner of the possessor (rule 29); no second *the* is written, so the construct takes none.
`נָא` takes the whole formula *I pray thee* with its pronouns (rule 30), leaving the dative `לְ` `unrepresented` beside a bare English indirect object.
